Farmer's Delight Wiki.text: "Farmer's Delight is a mod that gently expands upon farming and cooking in Minecraft. Using a simple cooking system and a few familiar ingredients, you'll be able to prepare a wide variety of hearty meals: from sandwiches to salads and stews, from beautiful desserts to mouth-watering feasts, no ingredient will be left behind in your kitchen! It also introduces a rich set of utilities: a way to improve the very soil your crops grow in, a brand new kind of tool to scavenge resources with, cute decorations for your builds, and many blocks and items to help you on your adventure!"

Blocks.text: This is a list of [https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Block blocks] from Farmer's Delight.

Crops.text: "Wild Crops spawn occasionally in nature at different biomes and climates. Since they're wild, a patch may not be very edible or fruitful, but will usually yield a single seed or plantable when broken. Rarely, seed-bearing wild crops may drop a unit of edible produce. You can also shear the patch to relocate it as decoration." - [https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/wiki/Wild-Crops Crops Section], "Farmer's Delight introduces a few new mechanics for early-game: new tools to help you out, and new things to look out for!" Here you'll find all the useful steps needed for a smooth start!…

Carrot.text: Carrots are a crop with new functions in Farmer's Delight. All vanilla properties of carrots are the same.

Feasts.text: Feasts are very large meals, which can be placed as a block to provide multiple servings to players.

Effects.text: "Farmer's Delight introduces a few new status effects to Minecraft. This page explains what they do, and how to get them.

Addon Mods.text: {| class="sortable fandom-table" !Image !Mod !Description !Author/s !Since Minecraft Version !Latest Minecraft Version

Finger Foods.text: Finger Foods are a type of food found in Farmer's Delight. They are small portions of food, meant to be eaten out of the hand. Some foods can be created in a crafting table, while others require a Cooking Pot.

Drinks.text: Drinks are a type of food found in Farmer's Delight. They can be created in a Cooking Pot or crafted. They do not restore hunger, but provide effects and minor benefits.

Crates.text: Crates are block variations of various crops, which can be crafted with 9 of the respective crop, and can be crafted back into the crop. They function similar to hay bales, though with differing textures.

Food.text: Types of food are separated based upon the amount of saturation healed.

Comfort.text: Comfort, [https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/wiki/Effects per the Farmer's Delight mod page], allows the player to maintain natural regeneration even if they're too hungry to do so normally. This is indicated by a silver sheen scrolling over the health meter.

Advancements.text: There are currently 22 advancements in Farmer's Delight. This page splits them into "growing" advancements, "cooking" advancements, and "cutting" advancements based off of their positions in the advancement tree.

Cabinet.text: The Cabinet (formerly Pantry) is a decorative storage block. it has the same storage as a normal chest. There is a unique model for each vanilla wood type.

Decorations.text: This is a list of the current decorative items in Farmer's Delight.

Decomposition.text: Decomposition is the process in which Organic Compost blocks become Rich Soil.

Potato.text: Potatoes can now be found in the "Wild" variant. These can be found in colder biomes (between temperatures of 0.3 and 1.0). They grow on Grass blocks.

Mutton Chops.text: A Raw Mutton Chop is a raw meat food item added by the Farmer's Delight mod.

Knife.text: The Knife is a new category of tool/weapon, aimed at preparing ingredients and foraging resources from plants and animals.

Nether's Delight.text: Welcome to the Nether's Delight Wiki!Nether's Delight is a mod that expands upon Farmer's Delight with features based around the Nether.

Meals.text: Meals are a type of food found in Farmer's Delight. They consist of salads, stews, and plated meals. They can be created in a Cooking Pot (with the exception of salads, which are made in a crafting table).

Pet Foods.text: Pet Foods are a type of food found in Farmer's Delight. When fed to their associated mob, they will grant certain effects. They can be created in a Cooking Pot or Crafting Table.

Nourishment.text: Nourishment, [https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/wiki/Effects per the Farmer's Delight mod page], prevents players from losing hunger or saturation through exhausting actions, such as running, jumping and attacking mobs. This effectively extends the hunger bar beyond its saturation limit, delaying the time before players need to eat again.

Pumpkin Slices.text: Pumpkin slice is a food item added by the Farmer's Delight mod.

Raw Salmon Slices.text: Two Raw Cod Slices can be obtained by cutting [https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Raw_Salmon Raw Cod] with a Knife on a Cutting Board.

Mushroom Colony.text: The Red & Brown Mushroom Colony is a part of the 18 crops of Farmer's Delight.

Fruits Delight.text: Welcome to the Fruits Delight Wiki![https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fruits-delight Fruits Delight] is a Farmer's Delight addon that adds fruits, jelly, juice, and fruit-based food.

Wild Crop.text: Wild Crops are the natural, uncultivated forms of farmable crops, growing across nature.

Seeds.text: In Farmer's Delight, there are multiple added seeds. This includes, cabbage seeds, and tomato seeds (similar to wheat). However, there are also other plants that use their food item as their seed item, such as: rice, tomatoes, and onions (similar to carrots and potatoes). These seeds can be obtained from their wild variants.

Tomato Vines.text: Wild Tomatoes are a new wild crop added by Farmer's Delight. They appear as "non-spiked floor vines covered in tiny tomatoes."

Sweets.text: Sweets are a type of food found in Farmer's Delight. They consist of pies, cakes, cookies, and frozen treats. They can be created in a crafting table and Cooking Pot.

Sweet Berry Cheescake.text: The Sweet Berry Cheesecake is a place-able food item added by the Farmer's Delight mod.
